# Gabriel Castillo | Backend and Integration Engineer

> Backend developer based in Tunja, Colombia. More than three years of experience in backend systems, integrations, SQL, production support and internal tools. Works in Spanish and English (B2).

- Current role: BI & Data Analytics Intern at Keyrus Colombia, since July 2026

Gabriel develops APIs and asynchronous workflows and diagnoses production failures by tracing data and messages through SQL, logs and code. His professional work includes financial messaging, electronic invoicing, regional benefits platforms and internal tools.

## Professional experience

- Keyrus Colombia, BI & Data Analytics Intern (July 2026 to present): designed and built an internal Django application that analyzes files and estimates effort for the team, with a DRF API, Celery/Redis background processing, PostgreSQL and automated tests in GitHub Actions. Also prepares and validates data with SQL and Python.
- TotalDev SAS, freelance Fullstack Developer (February 2025 to March 2026): added SWIFT MT support (MT103, MT202) and automated ISO 20022 conversion to a Java/Apache Camel interbank gateway. Developed the core modules of an electoral inventory platform (bulk imports, regional permissions, queued PDF generation) and built a plant inventory PWA, event guest registration with single-use QR codes and Laravel/Filament content panels.
- PARQ, Fullstack Developer (November 2024 to July 2025): maintained NestJS services sharing a PostgreSQL database, diagnosed production data inconsistencies and extended the SATCOM, Siigo and Alegra electronic invoicing connectors with queued resend of failed invoices and per-request tracing. Built country-specific rates, queued bulk membership creation and the Next.js corporate site. Worked with queues, scheduled jobs, OpenAPI and Docker/Portainer.
- SEREMPRE, Backend Developer (January 2023 to November 2024): built Laravel APIs for regional benefits, training and insurance platforms and handled L2/L3 production incidents with SQL, code review and Sentry. Worked on reporting, queued jobs and Docker/DDEV environments.

## Skills and scope

- Backend: Python, Django, DRF, TypeScript, NestJS, PHP, Laravel, Java, Apache Camel and REST APIs.
- Data and messaging: SQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle/PL-SQL, Redis, Celery, CSV/Excel reporting, Power BI and Tableau.
- Operations: production incident diagnosis, Docker, Portainer, GitHub Actions and OpenAPI.
- Kubernetes, Terraform and observability are personal project practice, not employer-operated production experience.
- AI Engineer, MLOps, DBA, DevSecOps and Sysadmin are areas of interest or transition, not current professional titles.
